<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useDnD, useDnDMonitor } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

// The drag as reactive state, anywhere under the provider.
const { status, active, over, pointer } = useDnD();

const rows = computed(() => [
  { name: 'status', value: status.value },
  { name: 'active', value: active.value?.id ?? '—' },
  { name: 'over', value: over.value?.id ?? '—' },
  { name: 'pointer', value: pointer.value ? `${Math.round(pointer.value.x)}, ${Math.round(pointer.value.y)}` : '—' },
]);

// Every drag's events, wherever it starts. The newest first.
const events = ref<{ id: number; text: string }[]>([]);
let count = 0;
const log = (text: string) => {
  events.value = [{ id: ++count, text }, ...events.value].slice(0, 5);
};

useDnDMonitor({
  onDragStart: ({ active }) => log(`start   ${active.id}`),
  onDragOver: ({ over }) => log(`over    ${over?.id ?? '—'}`),
  onDragEnd: ({ active, over }) => log(`end     ${active.id} → ${over?.id ?? '—'}`),
  onDragCancel: ({ active }) => log(`cancel  ${active.id}`),
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="panel">
    <h4>useDnD()</h4>
    <dl>
      <template v-for="row in rows" :key="row.name">
        <dt>{{ row.name }}</dt>
        <dd :class="{ live: row.value !== '—' && row.value !== 'idle' }">{{ row.value }}</dd>
      </template>
    </dl>
    <h4>useDnDMonitor()</h4>
    <ol class="events">
      <li v-for="event in events" :key="event.id">{{ event.text }}</li>

  type CollisionDetection,
  type DnDEndEvent,
  type Key,
} from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Desk from './Desk.vue';
import { magnet } from './magnet';

const DETECTORS: Record<string, CollisionDetection> = {
  pointerFirst,
  pointerWithin,
  rectIntersection,
  closestCenter,
  closestCorners,
  magnet,
};
const names = Object.keys(DETECTORS);
const mode = ref('pointerFirst');

// The ranking of the current frame, best first: a wrapper around the chosen function
// records it, so the targets can show their rank.
const ranked = shallowRef<Key[]>([]);
const collision = computed<CollisionDetection>(() => {
  const detect = DETECTORS[mode.value]!;
  return (args) => (ranked.value = detect(args));
});

const result = ref('Drag the pin or the card over the targets');
const onEnd = ({ over }: DnDEndEvent) => {
  ranked.value = [];
  result.value = over ? `Dropped on ${over.id}` : 'Dropped on nothing';
};
const onCancel = () => {
  ranked.value = [];
  result.value = 'Cancelled';
};
</script>

import type { CollisionDetection, Coordinates, Rect } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

/** How far the point is from the rect: 0 inside it. */
const gap = (rect: Rect, point: Coordinates) =>
  Math.hypot(
    Math.max(rect.left - point.x, 0, point.x - rect.right),
    Math.max(rect.top - point.y, 0, point.y - rect.bottom),
  );

/**
 * A collision detection of your own: what is under the pointer first; in a gap, the
 * nearest target within 40px of it. Small targets get easier to hit, and empty space
 * far from any target still drops nowhere.
 */
export const magnet: CollisionDetection = ({ hits, pointer, candidates }) => {
  if (hits.length) return hits;
  return candidates
    .filter((candidate) => gap(candidate.rect, pointer) <= 40)
    .sort((a, b) => gap(a.rect, pointer) - gap(b.rect, pointer))
    .map((candidate) => candidate.id);
};

    <h4>{{ title }}</h4>
    <ol>
      <li v-for="event in events" :key="event.id">{{ event.text }}</li>
      <li v-if="!events.length" class="empty">Nothing heard yet</li>
    </ol>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>
.log {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent);
  font: 11px/1.6 ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}

h4 {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 600;
  opacity: 0.55;
}

ol {
  min-height: 70px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  white-space: pre;
}

li:first-child {
  color: #42b883;
}

li.empty {
  color: inherit;
  opacity: 0.45;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Book from './Book.vue';

const props = defineProps<{ id: string; title: string }>();
const books = defineModel<{ id: string; title: string; hue: number }[]>({ required: true });

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
// Same group: the two shelves exchange books, as long as one provider owns both.
const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(list, { id: props.id, items: books, group: 'books' });
</script>

<template>
  <section class="shelf" :class="{ over: isOver }">
    <h3>{{ title }}</h3>
    <ul ref="list" class="books">
      <Book v-for="book in items" :key="book.id" :book="book" />
    </ul>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>
.shelf {

  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);

}

.shelf.over {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #42b883 60%, transparent);
